TITLE: Stare at the center and the dots disappear?
NEXT: NEXT: You can't read with the corner of your eye?

EN.가운데 십자(+)만 16초 동안\n가만히 보세요:
Look only at the center cross (+)
for 16 seconds
EN.눈을 움직이지 않는 게 비법!: The trick is to keep your eyes still!
EN.가운데 + 에서 눈을 떼지 마세요: Don't look away from the center +
EN.눈 세포는 \"바뀌는 것\"에\n크게 반응해요:
Eye cells react strongly
to things that change
EN.계속 똑같으면\n신호를 점점 줄여요:
If nothing changes,
they send weaker and weaker signals
EN.신호가 꺼진 빈자리는\n뇌가 주변 색으로 메워요:
Where the signal goes quiet,
your brain fills in the color around it
EN.눈은 사실 조금씩 떨려요\n또렷한 점은 그때마다 \"바뀜!\":
Your eyes actually jiggle a little.
A sharp dot "changes" every time
EN.흐린 점은 떨려도 별 차이가 없어\n금방 사라져요:
A blurry dot barely changes when they jiggle,
so it fades quickly
EN.눈의 비밀 다섯 편, 끝!: That's all five Secrets of the Eye!
